in_arabic.name: مُغيث
in_arabic.meaning: المغيث اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني من يعين وينصر
in_arabic.long_meaning: المغيث من أسماء الله الحسنى، وهو اسم الفاعل من غاث يغيث، ويعني من يعين وينصر عباده، ويغيثهم برحمته وفضله. ورد ذكر هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران آية 150: وَإِن يَنصُرْكُمُ اللَّهُ فَلَن تَغْلِبُوا وَإِن يَخْذُلْكُمْ فَمَن ذَا الَّذِي يَنصُرُكُم مِّن بَعْدِهِ وَعَلَى اللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ

in_urdu.name: مغيث
in_urdu.meaning: مغيث اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، معنی ہے مدد کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: مغيث اللہ کے اسماء حسنیٰ میں سے ایک ہے، جو عربی جڑ غيث سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مدد کرنا یا امداد کرنا۔ یہ نام ان خوبصورت ناموں میں شامل ہے جو اللہ کی صفات کو ظاہر کرتے ہیں، خاص طور پر اس کی مدد کرنے اور اپنے بندوں کی حفاظت کرنے کی صلاحیت۔

in_hindi.name: मुगीस
in_hindi.meaning: मुगीस अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, जिसका अर्थ है मदद करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुगीस अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, जो अरबी मूल से निकला है और जिसका अर्थ है मदद करना या सहायता प्रदान करना। यह नाम उन सुंदर नामों में से एक है जो अल्लाह की विशेषताओं को प्रकट करते हैं, विशेष रूप से उसकी मदद करने और अपने सेवकों की रक्षा करने की क्षमता।

in_pashto.name: مغيث
in_pashto.meaning: مغيث د الله ښوو نومونو څخه يو دی، معنی یې د مرستې کوونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: مغيث د الله تعالی ښوو نومونو څخه يو دی، چی د عربي کلمې غيث څخه اخیستل شوی دی، معنی یې د مرستې کوونکی یا د امداد کوونکی. دا نوم د الله تعالی د صفاتو څخه يو دی، کوم چی د هغه د مرستې او د خپلو بندګانو د حفاظت کولو توانایی څرګندوي.

in_english.name: Mughees
in_english.meaning: Mughees is one of Allah's beautiful names, meaning the one who helps
in_english.long_meaning: Mughees is one of the beautiful names of Allah, derived from the Arabic root 'غيث' (Ghayth), which means to help or to aid. This name is significant in Islamic tradition as it reflects one of Allah's attributes: the ability to assist and protect His servants. The name Mughees is mentioned in the context of Allah's names (Asmaul-Husna) that highlight His benevolent and supportive nature. In Islamic culture, names like Mughees are chosen for their deep spiritual meanings and connections to Quranic teachings.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mughees holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic world, not just for Muslims but also for non-Muslim communities in some regions. It is a name given to a person who is considered a leader, a guide, or a mentor. In various Islamic and Middle Eastern cultures, it is often used as a title for scholars, teachers, and imams, reflecting their role in guiding and leading their students or followers. In some Muslim communities, the title is also used for reputed elders, community leaders, and prominent members of society.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Mughees is deeply rooted in Islamic beliefs, where guidance and following the right path are fundamental concepts. The name reflects the idea of a role model, a guiding figure, and a beacon of light. In Islamic teachings, Allah is described as the ultimate guide and the one who leads humanity to the right path, as mentioned in the Quran (Surah Al-An’am, 6:35). By bestowing the name Mughees upon a child, parents express their hope and aspiration that their child will grow up to be someone who guides, leads, and inspires others, contributing positively to their communities and adhering to the teachings of Islam.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Guide, Leader" symbolizes One who guides, leads or shows the way. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mughees serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of guide, leader.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Mughees was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad The name Mughees carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Mughees was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad and is mentioned in various Hadiths.
